build_AudioVisualModel: build an AudioVisualModel instance with lipreading, identity, UNet, and classifier networks for audio-visual separation
run_AudioVisualModel_forward: run the AudioVisualModel forward pass to predict speech separation masks from mixed audio and visual inputs
create_gt_masks: create ground-truth separation masks from clean audio specs and mixed audio specs using complex ratio masking
compress_gt_masks: compress ground-truth masks using hyperbolic or sigmoidal compression functions for training stability
extract_visual_features: extract lipreading and identity visual features and fuse them for audio-visual UNet mask prediction
